description: Weather for any place on Earth: current conditions (temperature, feels-like, wind, humidity, pressure, cloud, precipitation), the next 48 hours hour by hour and a 7-day forecast with highs, lows and rain, in metric and imperial units, plus active official weather alerts for US locations. Place by name or coordinates. Data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0) and the US National Weather Service. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"weather_forecast"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/weather?q=New+York

q.description: place name (required unless lat/lon), e.g. Berlin or Austin, TX
